D1_syntax.notes: Benchmark covers all PML syntax from original: -- comments, --$m, --ONERROR, GOLABEL, LABEL, import, using namespace, handle/elsehandle/endhandle, if/elseif/endif, SYSCOM, SAVEWORK, UNCLAIM ALL, FINISH, variable declarations, $! substitution, pipe-delimited strings, ARRAY literal, OBJECT DATETIME(), method chains.

D2_objects_methods.description: PML object and method usage coverage
D2_objects_methods.notes: All objects from original present in benchmark: ARRAY(), DATETIME(), MEASURE(), UNIT(), PMLTAGS(), RAMCOMMONLOGGER(). All method calls preserved: .year(), .month(), .date(), .hour(), .minute(), .string(), .split(), .append(), addHeading(), setunits(), dbref(), lstflt, exportasxls(), writeErrorDataToExcel().

D3_control_flow.notes: Error handling via ONERROR/GOLABEL preserved. Conditional logic with if/endif for grid.size() checks preserved. Error handler block with handle any/endhandle preserved. Variable scoping with var/! local preserved.

D4_namespaces_imports.notes: All three namespace imports preserved: 'Aveva.Engineering.Tags.Pml', 'Aveva.Core.Presentation', 'Aveva.Engineering.Tags'. Single-quote string delimiters preserved as in original.

D5_error_handling.notes: Original top-level --ONERROR GOLABEL /Error preserved. Error handler block at LABEL /Error with handle any/endhandle preserved. Error log file path with timestamp preserved. SAVEWORK and UNCLAIM ALL preserved.

D6_data_patterns.notes: Empty value patterns (split + append chain) preserved. Common attributes 2D array (12 rows, attributePath → displayName) preserved. Replace data patterns (38 rows, value → NA mapping) preserved. All export sections (MTR, RDL, DOC, ALL, 3D, RDL-dataset) with their filter conditions preserved.
